description: This file contains the PHP source code for the 'Returns' class within the Opencart admin model for sales. It manages customer return operations including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving return records and their histories in the database.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: A class within the Opencart admin model for handling return operations related to sales, interfacing with the database to perform CRUD operations and retrieve return data.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Inserts a new return record into the database with provided data and returns the last inserted ID.

methods.name: editReturn
methods.description: Updates an existing return record identified by return_id with provided data.

methods.name: deleteReturn
methods.description: Deletes a return record and its associated histories from the database based on return_id.

methods.name: getReturn
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific return, including customer and status data.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Fetches a list of returns based on optional filters, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Returns the total count of returns matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnStatusId
methods.description: Returns the count of returns with a specific return_status_id.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnReasonId
methods.description: Returns the count of returns with a specific return_reason_id.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnActionId
methods.description: Returns the count of returns with a specific return_action_id.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds an entry to the return history, updating the status and optionally notifying the customer.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history records for a specific return.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of histories for a specific return, including comments and status changes.
